page.layout: Two columns of scripture references with page numbers under one heading. Left column with page references at its right, then a centred heading "AD GALAT[?]" and a second heading "AD EPHES[?]" below it. Right column, beside the upper part of the left column, separated by a vertical rule.; One column of page references at the right edge, with the left part of each line cut off. Above and below the column are the fragments "TAS." and "IOS.", which are the ends of capitalised headings.; One column of Scripture references on the right side of the scan, running top to bottom: references in the left cell, page and paragraph numbers in the right cell. Three centred capital headings divide the column (AD PHILIPPENSES, AD COLOSSENSES, I. AD THESSALONICENSES). At the foot, a signature "yyyy 2" at the left with "19.20." at the right.
page.notes: Doubtful readings: "AD GALAT" and "AD EPHES" are partly hidden at the edge; the endings are marked [?]. "26.t.9" and "101.t.12" are hidden at their right edge. The right column shows only its first two lines. The number after "32.t.", on the line for C.IV.4, is printed in an old-style form that I read as 10; it is marked [?]. The top line "576.t.16" is the continuation of an entry from the part of the page cut off above. The lower-right "19.20." sits on the same line as the signature "yyyy 2".
